steps.say: Hepatitis B prodrome is masquerading as serum sickness before jaundice. Fever with urticarial rash and symmetrical polyarthritis is forming the prodrome. steps.say: Hepatitis C is playing two joint games at once. Non-deforming rheumatoid-like polyarthritis is sparing the joint architecture. Mixed cryoglobulinemic vasculitis is adding the second face. Monoclonal IgM kappa against polyclonal IgG with rheumatoid factor activity is defining type II disease. Two joint faces are sharing one virus.

steps.say: Rubella is stiffening adult female joints transiently. Wild infection with RA27/3 vaccine strains is triggering the synovitis. Transient stiffness after rubella is resolving itself.
